title: Generalizing Metropolis-Hastings for DAG Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.30291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fundamental challenge in Bayesian network structure learning lies in efficiently approximating the posterior distribution of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). For large, high-dimensional datasets, the task remains beyond the capabilities of current methods. This work advances Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms by introducing novel moves that simultaneously resample the parents for multiple nodes of the DAG. At the core of these moves is duet sampling, a new generalization of the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm that selects two proposal distributions from a pool at each iteration. One is used for generating a candidate state of the Markov chain and another for evaluating the return to the current state; both are ingredients of an appropriately crafted acceptance criterion. Pairing different proposal distributions provides additional freedom and enables constructing Markov chains that mix more efficiently than their basic Metropolis-Hasting

translated_abstract: 贝叶斯网络结构学习中的一个根本性挑战在于高效地近似有向无环图（DAG）的后验分布。对于大型高维数据集，这一任务仍然超出了现有方法的能力范围。本工作通过引入新颖的转移步骤来推进马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗算法的发展，这些步骤能够同时对DAG中多个节点的父节点集进行重采样。这些步骤的核心是“二重采样”，这是Metropolis-Hastings算法的一种新的推广形式，它在每次迭代中从提议分布池中选取两个提议分布：一个用于生成马尔可夫链的候选状态，另一个用于评估从候选状态返回当前状态的转移；两者共同构成了精心设计的接受准则的组成部分。将不同的提议分布进行配对提供了额外的自由度，使得能够构建出比基本Metropolis-Hastings算法混合效率更高的马尔可夫链（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了“二重采样”这一Metropolis-Hastings算法的新推广形式，通过在每次迭代中选取两个提议分布（一个生成候选状态、一个评估返回当前状态），实现了对DAG中多个节点父集的同时重采样，从而显著提升了贝叶斯网络结构学习中马尔可夫链的混合效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "duet sampling," a novel generalization of the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm that selects two proposal distributions per iteration—one for generating a candidate state and one for evaluating the return to the current state—enabling simultaneous resampling of parents for multiple DAG nodes and constructing Markov chains that mix more efficiently for Bayesian network structure learning.
